measurement_basis: committed Environment projection extension linked to focused tests and bounded live projection readback

outcome.implementation_change: The existing implementation-accountability projection now preserves bounded cross-project repository-owner audit evidence, exact audit and source references, the shared pressure identity, actionable native opportunity, and host responsibilities. It labels ownership owner-declared and keeps the systemwide native ratio, denominator, and migration readiness unestablished.
outcome.analysis_limit: This change makes existing evidence queryable. It does not transfer implementation responsibility, verify the owner classifications, establish agent discovery across sessions, or show that a host-language boundary has been removed.
